title: QQQ/KODEX200/GLD five-minute alpha-transfer battery
claim_boundary: This is a five-minute OHLCV projection of three previously researched mechanisms. It is not an exact port of crypto-native gross-8 sleeves and cannot validate inputs such as taker flow, open interest, funding, premium, FX, or Kimchi premium.

source_contract.transport: direct HTTPS first; r.jina.ai read-through transport may be used only when the provider rate-limits direct research access; archive the extracted provider JSON
source_contract.session_filter: regular exchange session only; timestamp denotes bar open
source_contract.corporate_action_adjustment: multiply intraday OHLC by the same-session Yahoo daily adjclose/close factor; volume is unchanged

cross_source_control.comparison: unadjusted close on matching UTC timestamps

source_contract.cache_policy: raw/extracted payloads remain local; committed result records hashes

calendar_contract.test_and_eval_use: report only; no selection, reranking, sign repair, or substitution
calendar_contract.cagr_denominator: full wall-clock split including idle periods

rex_htf_pullback_reclaim_5m.missing_crypto_inputs: taker imbalance is fixed to zero; volume z-score remains

persistent_barrier_mass_density_fade_5m.decision_clock: completed bars whose local minute is 00
persistent_barrier_mass_density_fade_5m.side: fade completed traversal through frozen persistence barriers

execution.signal_information: completed five-minute bar t and strictly prior rolling state only
execution.entry: next available regular-session five-minute bar open
execution.positioning: one position per policy/instrument; skip overlapping signals
execution.strict_mdd: entry cost, every held five-minute high/low, conservative favorable-then-adverse same-bar ordering, exit cost, idle history, and split-contained exits

integrity_gates.missing_interior_regular_session_bar: fail closed except provider-stable KRX no-trade/trading-halt intervals; never synthesize bars

transfer_decision.mechanism_control: same-clock direction flip has lower eval CAGR/MDD on every instrument
transfer_decision.decision: one frozen policy must pass every gate on all three instruments
